notes.title: 🩷🍴September News: Kitchen Appliances in Cat Cafe Manager 2!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/8942a91044d386a8e9b5fa614b24778a08131b3b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi there, purring pal🐈! [/p][p][/p][p]First of all, we just wanted to mention that [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354830/Cat_Cafe_Manager/"]Cat Cafe Manager[/url] is showing up on the ✨Steam Home Page✨ today, which is a pretty big deal for a small developer like us! This extra featuring also comes with a discount, so for those who don't own a copy yet, you can get it -65% off for the next 24 hours! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354830/Cat_Cafe_Manager/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And here is the rest of our newsletter about [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"]Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss[/url]! 🩷  

To begin, [b]we want to thank everyone who shared their thoughts, excitement, and questions [/b]so far. It's very helpful for us to hear how you feel about our still developing game. Keep in mind that everything we show in our newsletters is still a [b]work in progress[/b]. 👷🛠️[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🏊‍♀️Concept Artist Deep Dive[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]For this Deep Dive, we'd like to give the mic to [b]Esmeé, one of our talented game artists[/b]. She's been busy designing colorful kitchen appliances you can use to prepare any sort of [i]delish dish[/i] for your customers. Let's learn more about her workflow in ✨[b]Esmeé's Art Atelier✨[/b]![/p][p]

~~~
[i]🎤 Hi everyone! I'm [b]Esmeé[/b], and I create concept art for Cat Cafe Manager 2 alongside our art director, Carmen. In this newsletter, I'd like to show you what I've been cooking up. And yes, I mean that quite literally, because I've been working on [b]kitchen appliances[/b]![/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]💛[b]Let's Get Cookin'![/b]💛[/i][/p][p][i]In Cat Cafe Manager 2, you'll be able to create all sorts of dishes. With the right ingredients, you can follow different recipes by using [b]a variety of machines.[/b] [/i]

[i]My particular design challenge was to make each machine look as if they would actually be [b]able to create your envisioned dish[/b] [b]on their own. [/b]That way, the player (you!), can tend to other things that need your attention (like serving customers or scratching your favorite cafe cat behind the ear). [/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/2892e4f12044de92e517fa92d96683acd4a136d4.png"][/img][i]Concept Art of a Wok Pan[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]💛Needs More Whimsy!💛[/b][/i][/p][p][i]A microwave is just a microwave, so looking up references for an appliance like that is easy. But in the world of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"][u]Cat Cafe Manager 2[/u][/url], [b]some appliances need a more 💫whimsical touch💫.[/b] Sometimes, I need to come up with unique machines, which is a lot of fun but can also be tricky. I don’t know about you, but personally, I don’t have a candy machine in my kitchen to use as reference. [b]So… how do you go about designing one?🤔[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/04d9800b390f8f9795d66b7135ee68842a51c12a.png"][/img][i]Concept Art of Everyday Cooking Appliances[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]💛Making This Thing Work💛[/b][/i][/p][p][i]In the case of the candy machine, [b]I researched how real candy is handcrafted[/b]. I sketched everything out and noted each step (from kneading to pulling, and so on). I then put every step of the handcrafting process together, [b]combining them all into one big monstrosity of an appliance[/b]. Not because that's the design I want to go for, but because it [b]helps me visualize[/b] which elements would actually be needed in order to have a functioning candy machine.[b]🍬 [/b]After that, I take a step back and ask myself which parts of the process I can simplify or remove.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/b73185cae87d8a262d8eaf72bd526e7c9b5529a5.png"][/img][i]Candy Machine Research Sketches[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Once that step is done, I pick a sketch I like and [b]create a few variations of the object[/b]. While doing so, I keep in mind the angle from which I want the player character to approach and use the machine. When working on these appliances, I love drawing inspiration from [url="https://cdn.media.amplience.net/i/frasersdev/98012899_o_a3?fmt=auto&upscale=false&w=767&h=767&sm=scaleFit&$h-ttl$"][u][b]Play-Doh playsets[/b][/u][/url] and [url="https://www.habbo.com/"][u][b]Habbo Hotel[/b][/u][/url][b] furniture[/b].🩷[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/d5402c6280b471d42792e0e4e09d5079e5b591dc.png"][/img][i]Concept Art of Possible Variations[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/08628cc6810dd442f917fac65e4ba6b2a1666f09.png"][/img][i]Final Concept Art, Ready to Be Exported as an Image (in PNG Format)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]After receiving a round of feedback from [b]lead artist Carmen[/b] and/or[b] creative director Rick[/b], I refine the sketch we like best. Depending on the complexity of the object, I also draw a side or back perspective for our[b] 3D-modeller Mischa[/b] and add some notes. [/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]🍭[b]And...[/b] [b]TADA[/b]! that is how you end up with a Candy Machine design that looks both fun and functional! :-) Below, you can see what it looks like when these 2D concepts are translated to 3D![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/fd79237e6e774ad2c5740ab604e7a45dd40253b7.png"][/img][i]The 3D Model of the Candy Machine![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/46b63ceb1b933c70e356884ef5e8801db54460ff.png"][/img][i]... aaand From Another Angle! Yay![/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Thank you so much for reading [b]Esmeé's Art Atelier[/b]! I hope you learned something new and that it got you excited for all the cool appliances that are still in the works. [/i][/p][p][i]~~~[/i][/p][p][/p][p]🍰[/p][p]Aside from Esmeé's hard work on the kitchen appliances, our programming team has been just as busy creating buzz in the cafe kitchen! We recently [b]finished the basic foundations of cafe gameplay[/b], which is super exciting! We can't wait to show you more once we've refined the rough edges, dusted off some surfaces, and added a few cherries on top! 😸[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🫶Games We Love & Support[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We want to congratulate our friends from Crinkle Cut Games, who very successfully launched their game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274620/Discounty/"][u][b]Discounty[/b][/u][/url] last month! In this fun RPG, you get to manage your own supermarket. Get caught up in small-town drama, organise and plan your shop's layout, and strike lucrative trade deals as you expand your secretive aunt's business empire. Go check them out if you're interested in not just opening a cat cafe, but a discount supermarket, too! 🛒[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274620/Discounty/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]😽Cats Awareness Sale[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Both [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354830/Cat_Cafe_Manager/"][u][i]Cat Cafe Manager[/i][/u][/url]and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"][u][i]Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss[/i][/u][/url] have been selected to be part of the [b]Cat Awareness Sale[/b] on Steam, organised by our friends at [url="https://www.devcatsgames.com/"][u]Devcats[/u][/url]! This celebration will run from[b] September 8th - 18th[/b] and features a wide variety of cute cat games for you to play. Go check it out once it's live, for there is no such thing as too many cat games. 🐈[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/1a20d89851d4ae0d2654d3d6a89532601eb3b8a6.png"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoyed this month's newsletter! Until the next one in November, you can follow us on [url="https://www.instagram.com/catcafemanager/"][u]Instagram[/u][/url], [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@roostgames"][u]TikTok[/u][/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/roostgames.bsky.social"][u]BlueSky[/u][/url], [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/catcafemanager/"][u]Reddit[/u][/url], and [url="https://discord.gg/rGrKWWX6UQ"][u]Discord[/u][/url] & [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"][u]wishlist Cat Cafe Manager 2 on Steam[/u][/url]! 🥰[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Let's talk more soon!🫶[/p][p][/p][p][b]- Claire & Irene[/b] (and the rest of [b]Roost Games[/b]🪺)[/p][p][/p][p]Connect with us:[/p][p]💜[url="https://discord.com/invite/sAXW2mx"]Discord[/url][/p][p]💙[url="https://bsky.app/profile/didplcxhbhtgmyyrn7fj7gxp7cktw5"]BlueSky[/url][/p][p]❤️[url="https://www.instagram.com/catcafemanager/"]Instagram[/url] [/p][p]🧡[url="https://www.reddit.com/r/catcafemanager/"]Reddit[/url][/p][p]💛[url="https://www.tiktok.com/@roostgames"]TikTok[/url][/p][p]💚 [url="https://catcafemanager.com/"]Newsletter[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/77d9cce1915a575a64d9e9e651baa7d7d98f3fac.png"][/img][/p][p] [i]"Day 3 of renovations. Bonner found this postcard in our new attic. It looks... quite old. And quite mysterious. I shall have to see what else I can dig up!

notes.title: 😻August News: Kittens in Cat Cafe Manager 2!!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/feaa28333cdacd2cf15edd2bd0c5194458c2800e.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi friends!🐈[/p][p][/p][p]We hope July has been good to you! Here at Roost Games, we had a great month. We worked on some really cool new stuff we know you're going to love. Seriously, we're [b]so[/b] excited to talk about our [b]cutest CCM2 feature yet[/b]. Prepare yourself for some [i]serious[/i] baby fever, because...[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🍼Cat Cafe Manager 2 will have KITTENS![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Whereas cat cafes in the original [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354830/Cat_Cafe_Manager/"]Cat Cafe Manager[/url] were only inhabited by grown cats, things will be a [i]little[/i] different in your city establishment in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"][i]Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss[/i][/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Because you know, when two cats love each other very, [i]very[/i] much... there's a chance they will surprise you with ✨[b]AN ADORABLE KITTEN!✨😻[/b][/p][p][/p][p]👇Just look at this beautiful little family! 👇 [i](Sound on)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLiTEO7eTe4"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]💕As you can see,[b] kittens will be fully-fledged inhabitants of your cat cafe[/b]. They need to be nurtured, fed, and loved as much as your big cats do. Perhaps even a little more!🎀

Our[b] lead game designer Rick[/b] will fill you in on some more details:[/p][p][/p][p][i]🎤"We're still working out the exact details for kitten gameplay, but we do know that when two cats get close enough, your cat cafe might be blessed with a little kitten! [b]Kittens inherit visual traits from their parents, but may also acquire their stats and personality quirks.[/b] Every kitten is [b]a happy accident[/b], though, so don't expect to tactically breed the ultimate cafe cat.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Of course, kittens are incredibly cute, so your customers will be [b]extra delighted [/b]by them. Since they're babies, they also tend to require a little more care than your grown-up cats. They get tired a lot more quickly, so expect them to take lots of cat naps. Growing up is hard work, after all!"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/66c9091e2dc89decf9b79a9af4e0a4c17187d3e3.png"][/img][i]Take your kittens out to explore the world with you![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/503c28fbb44b5b4351decd4ab619b05a4f94b6ea.png"][/img][i]Adult cats will help you take care of their babies[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]⭐New Cat, Who Dis? [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]You might have already noticed that it's not just the [b]kittens[/b] that are new. [b]Our bigger cats have a new look to them as well! [/b]We decided we wanted to give the purring stars of [i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"]Cat Cafe Manager 2[/url][/i] a little make-over to make them look even cuter. And so we did! 😻[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/fd371c0e8742e63a876f9e795eab3d8a2d37c1aa.png"][/img][i]✨A glow-up!✨[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Our [b]lead artist Carmen[/b] explains how these updated design choices came to be:

🎤[i]"Even though we were already pretty happy with our initial cat designs, we still felt there was room for improvement. That left us with the following question: [b]How do we increase the cuteness of our cat designs?[/b][/i]

[i]Simpler, rounder shapes equal more adorableness, which is why I started by adding more [b]inflated, circular forms[/b]. I drew inspiration from beloved characters like the Dutch cartoon rabbit [url="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhlvnuoUx-1fQGmRyexa3BuOr5r-1W6aPG4J-i-VSjRnRzN8TLoPGGEa6N4Ksi5ghC9_5_KgeYaDh2ffDlu4eioCETCtQy-CNo9E-zWCbxvmEfVD3LcJfPdduchQ8sduglh6vTMmAkSUhTpC79LtlBKOiersWU2Jl5LWEoqGO1k6sa6wgi43ndoKxCq1w/s750/Nijntje.webp"]Nijntje[/url] (internationally known as Miffy), who show that simplicity can be highly effective to achieve that endearing look. With that in mind, I changed the head shape of our cats from[b] an oval to a circle. [/b][/i]

[i]Next, I [b]softened every sharp corner [/b]I could find to create a sweeter, friendlier look. I simplified the face by reducing black lines and positioning the eyes and snout closer together. The end result is a cat design that is even squishier, softer, and snugglier than before! [/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Et voilà! That sums up every ingredient needed to create the ultimate cute cat design!"[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/d7ba2559efa6adacff96612afaeabd1787610822.png"][/img][i]Keep an eye on your kittens, as they'll always be up to something...![/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]😽Smitten With Each and Every Kitten![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]But [b]Carmen[/b], what about the design process of the brand-new bouncing babies? How did those little floofballs come to be? 👶[/p][p][/p][p]🎤[i]"To establish the kitten designs, I studied the fresh look of the adult cats first to figure out a way to make them [b]even[/b] [b]more[/b] adorable. The key was making the kittens smaller and somehow rounder than the adult cats. [/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]And so I [b]made their heads relatively large[/b] compared to the regular cat design and really leaned into that baby look. To top it all off, I added [b]the classic kitten triangle tail.[/b][/i][b]🩷 [/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]We're super happy with the updated cats and brand-new kittens, and we hope you are too![/i]😊[i]" [/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/7cd6fa142cd7c67ff205fde37bb46747c5e22240.png"][/img][i]Hello, baby![/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🎉Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We've got more exciting news to share! As Roost Games, we are super proud to announce that [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"]Cat Cafe Manager 2[/url][b] got selected for the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames"]Wholesome Games Celebration[/url][/b]!! This amazing event has JUST kicked off on Steam (running from August 7th until August 14th) and hosts a carefully curated lineup of upcoming games, new releases, discounts, and demos. We're in good company, so definitely check it out if you love cozy games as much as we do! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]🩷Games We Love: Kinder World: Mother Tree [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]This month, we would like to shout out a beautiful Kickstarter project from our friends at Lumi Interactive that helps you monitor and improve your mental health. [b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kinderworld/kinder-world-mother-tree/posts"]Kinder World: Mother Tree[/url][/b] is a cozy desktop companion that helps you take regular breaks to give your body and mind what it needs. 💛 [/p][p][/p][p]Their Kickstarter was funded within 15 hours and will be running until August 21st Curious? [b]Check out Kinder World: Mother Tree on [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kinderworld/kinder-world-mother-tree/posts"]Kickstarter[/url] now! [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ffb29bf47c460d2c50088049466803af49786af7.png"][/img][/p][p]--[/p][p][/p][p][b]We hope you enjoyed this month's newsletter[/b]. Until the next one, check us out on [url="http://discord.gg/sAXW2mx"]Discord[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/roostgames.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/catcafemanager/"]Instagram,[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@roostgames"]TikTok[/url], and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/catcafemanager/"]Reddit[/url]. If you would like to receive these updates via email, you can [b][url="https://catcafemanager.com/"]subscribe to our newsletter[/url][/b][url="https://catcafemanager.com/"] on our website[/url]. 🩷 

Oh, and we'd [b]LOVE to hear your thoughts on the new cat designs and how you feel about the kittens! [/b]Let us know in the comments below so we can chat. 😸[/p][p][/p][p]And, as always, don't forget to [b]wishlist [i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"]Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss[/url][/i] [/b]if you haven't already.😽[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109590/Cat_Cafe_Manager_2_Big_City_Bliss/"][/dynamiclink]Let's talk soon!

Cheers,[/p][p] Claire & Irene (and the rest of Roost Games[b]🪺[/b]) [/p][p][/p][p]--[/p][p][/p][p]Connect with us:[/p][p]💜[url="https://discord.com/invite/sAXW2mx"]Discord[/url][/p][p]💙[url="https://bsky.app/profile/didplcxhbhtgmyyrn7fj7gxp7cktw5"]BlueSky[/url][/p][p]❤️[url="https://www.instagram.com/catcafemanager/"]Instagram[/url] [/p][p]🧡[url="https://www.reddit.com/r/catcafemanager/"]Reddit[/url][/p][p]💛[url="https://www.tiktok.com/@roostgames"]TikTok[/url][/p][p]💚 [url="https://catcafemanager.com/"]Newsletter[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🌼June News: Wildwoud Woods Concept Art + Decorating Your Cafe!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Hi there, fellow cat enthusiasts!🩷🐈  June has officially kicked off, so we want to begin by saying that we hope everyone had a wonderful month of May!🌸 Let's start the month off strong by getting you up to speed with[b][i] the latest Cat Cafe Manager 2 updates![/i][/b]😸   [/p][p][/p][h2]🦉Welcome to the Wildwoud Woods! [/h2][p][/p][p]Are you ready to call your fearless feline companion and explore the magical [b]Wildwoud Woods[/b], just outside the city?✨ Who knows, you might just find that rare ingredient you’ve been searching for forever, hiding in a berry bush or nestled underneath a mushroom.🍄  Our artists are working hard to make this forest feel magical, mystical, and a little mysterious...👀 We're excited to show you some of our[b] latest Wildwoud Woods[/b] concept art below!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/1d4cb2c5de6cf66df042d3b91a7fb121d7f4a5e0.png"][/img][i]Wildwoud Woods Concept Art[/i]  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/b3dbf4cfa05582615fbc91b2411884a63fc30317.png"][/img][i]Concept Art of Props and Details[/i]  [/p][p][/p][h2]🧑‍🍳We're COOKING![/h2][p][/p][p]As demonstrated above, we've already put a lot of love into the [b]explorable outside world [/b]of [i]Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss[/i] over the last couple of weeks. However, it's also important to give some much-needed attention to the most important place of all: [b]your cat cafe![/b]🐈 [/p][p][/p][p]In the next couple of weeks, we'll be focusing our efforts on setting up [b]gameplay for cooking, decorating, taking care of your cats, and serving your customers.[/b]  Additionally, we'll be working on [b]the cat cafe’s interior[/b], updating the temporary models and visuals we built for the Kickstarter trailer to new assets that will actually be there to play with when the game launches in Early Access. We hope to have more to share about this in the next couple of months!  [/p][p][/p][h2]🪑Decorating Your Cafe[/h2][p]There is something we [i]CAN [/i]share with you already, though: [b]a very early version of the cafe decoration tool[/b]! In the GIF below, you can see exactly what our [b]programmer Ernst [/b]has been working on:  [/p][previewyoutube="dd4dRHZpIo4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Early Version of the Cafe Decoration Tool[/i]  [/p][p][/p][h2]🤔So... What exactly is happening in the GIF?[/h2][p][/p][p]In the visual, you can see how Ernst opens up[b] the decoration menu[/b]. This menu allows him to see all the [b]furniture [/b]and [b]decoration [/b]pieces he has collected so far. Of course, you'll be able to furnish your cafe with more items than just chairs ([i]unless you want to transform your game into Chair Cafe Manager; we won’t judge![/i]🪑🪑😸).  Every item you place in your cafe can be [b]rotated and positioned anywhere you like[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]We’re obviously still early on in the process, but we can already tell it’s going to be so much fun to decorate your cafe with [b]all assets being fully 3D[/b]! Oh, and we also have some neat ideas for how p[b]ieces of furniture could interact [/b]with each other.  🏠[b]Ernst [/b]has also been working on a feature that will let you[b] expand your cafe[/b], allowing you to [b]create new rooms[/b] and [b]make your floor plan bigger[/b]. That feature still needs a little more time cooking in the oven, though, so we’ll save that for another time! notes.title: October News : Wrapping up the Kickstarter... Back to development!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re [b]back from vacation[/b], bursting with energy, and excited to start sending out Kickstarter rewards and continue working on [b]Cat Cafe Manager 2[/b]! ✨

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=25csdh]On Kickstarter, [/url] we managed to collect a whopping [b]88,957 EUR[/url][/b] from [b]2,063 backers[/b] - thank you all [b]SO SO[/b] much! With this money, we won't just be able to create the game of our dreams; we will also be in the position to add the following Stretch Goals: [b]Customizing[/b] your cafe’s outside, [b]Cat Connections[/b], [b]Romanceable NPCs[/b], and [b]Kittens[/b]! 😻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/b3e5d01dcdb13079ff6ef1667944bbc07f7737da.png[/img]

We also managed to unlock [b]two extra hearts[/b] of the [b]Community Goals[/b] with more than [b]2,000 Kickstarter backers[/b] and [b]400 TikTok followers[/b], which means, we’ve unlocked the adorable 🍌 [b]Banana cat hat[/b]!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/5cb409a57807dacbb59d8077a859ddc2628fca0c.png[/img]

[h3]Update on CCM2 Development:[/h3]

[i]Hi, a quick word from game designer [b]Rick[/b] here! We spent the last couple of months fully focused on the Kickstarter campaign, making sure we could show you just how [b]pretty[/b] the game is going to look. However, that also means it's been a while since we actually worked on [b]its gameplay[/b], which will be our main focus in the months to come! Programmer [b]Ernst and I[/b] will be diving back into [b]Unity[/b], the engine we use to build our game in. Time to fire those game development ovens back up![/i] 🧑‍🍳🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149257/98290c56e6b0ccd9360bdf7a7ba66aa59d3ff6c4.png[/img]

[i]Ernst will focus his efforts on [b]enhancing our development toolset[/b], which will allow us to build the game more quickly and smoothly in the future. It's safe to say that these are super exciting times on the game development front![/i] 👀

[b]We will be back next month with more updates about the development of Cat Cafe Manager 2![/b]

Don’t hesitate to [b]reach out[/b] to us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAXW2mx]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/catcafemanager/]Reddit[/url], [url=https://x.com/roostgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@roostgames]TikTok[/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/catcafemanager]Instagram[/url] if you have any [b]questions[/b] about the survey or anything else! - Irene & Claire

notes.title: 🌟 Last few hours of the Kickstarter! Next Stretch Goal: 😻Kittens!
notes.notes:
Hello, we're approaching the end of [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=956xis]the campaign[/url] and we have already reached the 70k€[b] stretch goal[/b]!!!! 🙀 😭 

[list]
[*] €50K unlocked: 🏪 [b]Cafe Outside Customization[/b]
[*] €60K unlocked: 🐱 [b]Cat Connections[/b]
[*] €70K unlocked: 💌 [b]Romanceable NPCs[/b]
[/list]
This means that a bunch of characters will become [b]romanceable[/b]! Get ready for gift-giving, cute dates, and unique story content for each romanceable NPC! 💌 🥰 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/d6973864c05461f3a66bcff68c07e858b0e49798.png[/img]

If we meet the next stretch goal at[b] €80k [/b](88,205 USD) we will include... [b]Kittens[/b] in the game! 😻 

🙀 These [b]tiny furballs [/b]require a little more care than your average feline... but aren't they CUTE?

💪 [b]Kittens [/b]start off with lower stats than most cats, but can become very good little kittens if you [b]spend the time & resources to nurture them[/b].

💖 If certain specific cats get close... your cat cafe might be [b]blessed with a new kitten [/b]soon! Be sure to take good care of the parents, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/e05ed7202aae14d4ef4d8aeaae0baa38856db360.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

We also wanted to share some details about the 🐟😻 [b]Adopting stray cats[/b] mechanic!

🧭 [b]Finding a stray cat[/b] for the first time will add it to your 📀 [b]Cat-o-Dex[/b].
Different strays will appear in different places. If you forget where you found one, you can easily check your Cat-o-Dex!

🌦️ Some strays will [b]only appear[/b] under certain [b]conditions[/b], such as a specific [b]time of day[/b] or [b]weather[/b]. But don't worry, kind folks in town might give you hints on how to find rare stray cats! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/9faf32fec03fc7c02ed75ba5edb11a590329b9c1.png[/img]

Once you [b]find a stray[/b], you can approach them and start a 🐟😻 [b]Stray Encounter[/b]!

These are [b]turn-based encounters[/b] where each turn, you decide how to approach the stray. Try to win their [b]Trust [/b]without [b]startling [/b]them!

✋ [b]Petting [/b]a stray cat is a great way [b]to earn lots of Trust[/b], but it may cause them to get skittish and [b]run away[/b]!

🥫 Most cats can't resist the [b]allure [/b]of [b]cat food[/b]. If they look ready to run, lure them back in with their [b]favorite [/b]treat.

🐱 Some of your [b]Cat Companions[/b] can also [b]help[/b]! Having them cuddle and play with the stray can [b]put the them at ease[/b] and win their [b]Trust[/b]!

For this mechanic, we got inspired by [b]the Pokémon safari zone [/b]and other pacifist turn-based RPGs. I hope you look forward to [b]finding all the stray cats and winning their trust[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

Here's a sneak peek of the [b]Wallpapers [/b] that backers of the 😎[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=956xis]COOL CAT tier[/url] or above will receive in a few weeks! They will be available in different sizes so you can use them for different screen types and devices! 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/7b7c96e9e38af7ee76057d347afc3458f2ac8b4c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/cbb31e57bc72876de58d4c4ed734a3a6430a5291.png[/img]

Finally, we're currently running a new pet contest on [url=https://x.com/roostgames/status/1841118904451473646]X/Twitter[/url] and on [url=discord.gg/sAXW2mx]Discord[/url]! We will add one lucky pet to the game, in one way or another. To participate, you can send us your pet picture(s) on this [url=https://x.com/roostgames/status/1841118904451473646]X/Twitter[/url] thread or on [url=discord.gg/sAXW2mx]Discord[/url]. We will pick the winner this weekend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/accae42a0c41974afe49570a92d1a1e88286b338.jpg[/img]

We will be back with another update soon after the campaign is done, to let you know how much we were able to raise, and what the next steps of development will be.

If you want to keep an eye yourself to see if we reach the Kittens stretch goal, you can head directly over to our[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roost-games/cat-cafe-manager-2?ref=956xis] Kickstarter page[/url].

THANKS SO MUCH EVERYONE!! 

Until then! <3

- Irene and the team at Roost Games

Take care! ✨❤️
Rick

This surprisingly energetic major update bring [b]sleeping cats[/b], a new [b]furniture set[/b] and [b]ingredient delivery[/b]! Let's dive in.

[h2]NEW FEATURE: 💤Sleepy Cats[/h2]
🐱Adding a new [b]Cat Need[/b]: [b]Sleep[/b].

At the [b]end of each workday[/b] cats with the Sleep Need (all cats after the first upgraded Stray Cat Lure) will want to [b]sleep in a cat bed[/b].

The 2 [i]Cat Litterbox[/i] Shrine upgrades have been changed to [b]'Cat Comforts'[/b], and now include [b]6 cat[/b] beds to unlock. Place these in your cafe for your cats to sleep in; but higher Sleep Need cats want better beds!

Cats that [b]cannot sleep in a bed[/b] because your bed score isn't high enough will [b]complain[/b] instead. The following day these cats will be [b]unavailable[/b] for 3 to 5 hours as they [b]sleep during the day[/b]. Better get them their catnap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/6c2cdb547acd99d2d36250f395463f7f4e17d3fe.png[/img]

🐱Have your [b]ingredients delivered[/b]!
Complete the game [i](by finishing all the Shrine Upgrades)[/i] to unlock Bonner's newly provided service!

Once unlocked, you can purchase the new Delivery Service at the [b]Food Market[/b] shop.
After purchasing, click the [b]🔁button[/b] next to an Ingredient at the Food Market shop to turn on [b]'auto delivery'[/b]. Once turned on, you will automatically purchase that ingredient whenever you run out! If you cannot afford it at this time, the game will give you a little notification, and turn off the auto delivery for now.

[h2]NEW CONTENT: ⛩️Eastern Teahouse Furniture Set[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/6a2eeb2858fac4001b52f5a950b6685243107d53.png[/img]
This new [b]high level[/b] furniture set includes tables, chairs, wallpapers, floors, kitchen utensils and decor that will allow you to turn your cat cafe into a beautiful teahouse, inspired by Chinese and Japanese designs.

We hope you'll use these to build a beautiful cafe!

[h2]MORE![/h2]
[list]
[*][b]CONTENT:[/b] New 🌺 outdoor plant decorations:
- Tulips [i](purchasable from the start)[/i]
- Bush [i](purchasable from the start)[/i]
- Sunflowers [i](unlocked in the Harvest Halloween Shrine Upgrade)[/i]
- Cat shaped bush [i](unlocked in the Tea House 1 Shrine Upgrade)[/i]
[*]🐱[b]CONTENT:[/b] Added 7 new 💇🏽hairstyles!
Remember you can change your hairstyle by  pressing ESC and selecting 'Edit Character'.
[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: More clear feedback on what stats get affected by having duplicates of a piece of furniture, when buying in the shop.
[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: Cats that are not available to entertain customers for any reason [i](because they are asleep or complaining about stress / playing)[/i] are now colored darker to indicate this a bit more.
[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: Cats complaining about wanting to play [i](because there are not enough Toys)[/i] now use their 'play' animations, to differentiate from complaining about wanting pets.
[*][b]FEEDBACK[/b]: New end of game text explains your newly unlocked options a bit more clearly, including your ability to re-adopt any cats you’ve given a Forever Home.
[*]🐱[b]FIX[/b]: Robocat9000 will not complain about food anymore.
[*]🐱[b]FIX[/b]: Cats who complain about wanting to Play or be Pet no longer slide around the cafe.
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Cats can no longer have multiple ‘Play’ or ‘Calm’ tasks anymore.
[*][b]FIX[/b]: Improved the language system when changing languages between saves.
[/list]

We really really hope you enjoy the update!
I put this in our update announcement, but I think it'd be good to repeat here:
[h3]The Naptime Update will be the final major update for Cat Cafe Manager.[/h3]

To be clear, this [b]won't mean we'll stop fixing bugs and issues[/b] that come up!
It's just that we've started prototyping and developing really exciting [b]new games[/b] to work on beyond CCM, and we're now at a point in development that we've gotta focus our small team's attention on them full-time.

I can't yet talk about these new games, but I can guarantee we'll keep doing what we do best: make [b]wholesome & interesting management games[/b]! We'll post [url=https://discord.com/invite/5dCbC895hs]on the Roost Games discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/roostgames]twitter[/url] once we can show stuff off!

Again, we really hope you enjoy the update. If you run into anything, or have any feedback, definitely let us know, OK? Until next time!

From me (Rick) and all of Roost Games (Rutger, Carmen, Joni and Sonya)...
[b]thanks so much for playing our little cat game![/b]

notes.title: Update #1: The Comfy Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ef323603df9d868b5cc474a9aab2c01ea7e732ae.png[/img]

Hullo there!
Are your feet up? Is your blankie all the way up to your chin? Hot coco and a purring cat nearby?
That's right, get comfy for the ✨[b]Comfy Update[/b]✨, the first big update for Cat Cafe Manager!

[h1]The Comfy Update[/h1]
First of all, I want to quickly thank each and every one of you that played Cat Cafe Manager! It's been a dream come true for us, a tiny 4 person studio, to see you enjoying the game, and telling us how you feel about it.
On that note, I also really want to thank everyone that shared [b]feedback[/b], [b]suggestions[/b] and [b]bug reports[/b] with us on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/5dCbC895hs]Discord[/url][/b] and the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1354830/discussions/]Steam forum[/url][/b]! It's been sooo helpful in determining what we can do to make Cat Cafe Manager a more relaxing, comfy experience for you!

This update is all about [b]quality of life[/b]! Giving you the tools to play CCM better and easier.
Let's comfortably slide right into the patch notes, shall we?

🐱 [i]Points with this icon were [b]Community Suggestions[/b]![/i]

[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🐱 You can now [b]sell[/b] your unwanted furniture in Decorate Mode!
[i]In the Decorate UI, select the piece of furniture you want to sell, and click the blue 'Sell' box. You'll get back 25% of the price you paid for the furniture![/i]
[*] 🐱 You can now select [b]which tasks[/b] a Staff member will perform.
[i]You can set them in the 'detail screen' for a Staff Member by checking or unchecking the little box next to a skill. This allows you to focus Staff Members on only serving customers, or only cooking food.[/i]
[*] 🐱 Added new Traits for Staff members which unlock the Cat Care and Maintenance skills.
[*] 🐱 You can now edit your character and cafe name while playing.
[i]Simply press ESC to go to the menu, which now has 2 new options: Edit Character & Edit Cafe Name.[/i]
[*] Added a new Gameplay option to [b]single press[/b] a key/button instead of holding it to perform actions.
[i]Go to Settings > Game, and tick the 'Tap to Perform Task' box there.[/i]
[/list]
[h2]UI ADDITIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🐱 The Autosave file now [b]includes the player name[/b] so you can have Autosaves of multiple games, and the game warns you if you start a game with the same name, to prevent accidentally overwriting it.
[*] When a Customer Group levels up (after getting a Friendship Level with a Regular) a [b]new screen[/b] will tell you what their new rewards and Needs are.
[*] 🐱 Added [b]arrow keys[/b] as valid control option for moving your character and camera for left-handed players.
[*] Food Menu UI now displays your recipe inventory and the [b]recipes you're currently missing[/b] that your customers sometimes want to order.
[*] 🐱 The Cat Roster UI now shows your[b] total score[/b] per Customer Group, so you can more easily determine which Customers will be happy with your cat roster.
[*] You can now open the Cat Roster UI when petting stray cats.
[*] 🐱 The Advertising UI now shows all the Needs and desired recipes of customers.
[*] Clearer indication when a Stray Lure [b]cannot attract more Strays[/b], and that Lure is removed from the shop. You'll also automatically get a refund on any Lures you own that can no longer attract Strays.
[*] 🐱 Added icons for[b] furniture style [/b]to the Shop and Decorate Mode, so you can see how much of a style you own.
[*] 🐱 Added sorting options to the Shop UI. Sort based on name [i](A>Z)[/i], price [i](low>high)[/i], furniture style or amount owned [i](least>most)[/i].
[*] 🐱 Added a number of how many of an ingredient you own in the Ingredient Shop, so you can more easily add the ones you need. [i](Tip: sort by 'amount owned' to see what you own the least of!)[/i]
[*] 🐱 You now get a notification whenever a piece of equipment[b] breaks[/b].
[*] 🐱 Added a button to [b]show walls[/b] in Decorate mode, so you can easily move / remove windows and doors.
[*] 🐱 The shops now show [b]how many[/b] of an item you already have in your inventory.
[*] Added a line in the shop clarifying that a Stat won't get added when you already have one of that piece of furniture in your cafe [i](duplicates don't add stats, except for Cat Needs like Toy & Food, and Toilets for customers)[/i].
[*] Explanation in the reward screen when you get a Stray Lure as a present, that it is, in fact, a Lure.
[*] 🐱 You can now [b]skip the customer count[/b] at the end of the day by clicking.
[*] 🐱 Fixed some readability issues in the Forever Home rewards.
[*] Improved how traits are displayed, especially when you have a lot of traits.
[*] Added some more indicators for controls to the Decorate Mode.
[*] 🐱 Serving food Tasks are now yellow instead of orange, so you can more easily see which Customers are waiting for orders to be delivered.
[/list]
[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Kitchen tasks now spawn at the [b]closest possible kitchen appliance[/b], instead of randomly, better allowing for multiple kitchens.
[*] 🐱 Customers with a "Comfort" need now automatically pick the [b]most comfortable free chair[/b] available.
[*] Staff now prioritizes rarer tasks like maintenance, cat care and cleaning, if they're able to perform those.
[*] Made almost all traits a little [b]more effective[/b].
[*] 🐱 End of the game story now triggers when the shrine is actually fully completed.
[/list]
[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some traits not applying their bonus correctly.
[*] Fixed some stats overlapping in the UI.
[*] 🐱 Fixed a few bugs related to relationship levels not displaying correctly.
[*] 🐱 Fixed the Cat HUD in the lower right sometimes shifting left and hiding cats when you had a lot of cats.
[*] 🐱 Fixed dialogue skipping when you were holding down a button when the dialogue popped up.
[/list]
If you have any questions about the update, be sure to fire away at us on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/5dCbC895hs]Discord[/url][/b] or the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1354830/discussions/]Steam forum[/url][/b]! We'll try to answer asap!

We've also made a whole bunch of personality traits for your cats and staff which affect their stats and behaviors. A cat might be a ‘groomer’ that cleans up other cats, a ‘hunter’ that finds its own food and doesn’t have to be fed, or a ‘chonker’ who eats more than most but is extra cute because of it.

With this, there is now an expanded ‘lure’ system: lures are placed outside of your cafe and used to win the trust of stray cats. There’s now more than 10, and each lures in different stray cats for you to win over. The rarest ones are extra weird!

[i]What sort of cat could possibly be lured in by a chunk of fallen meteorite?[/i]

[i]Want to expand your cafe? Advertise to ‘punks’, who pay in ‘materials’ needed for construction.[/i]

[list]

[*] You can now rotate all your props and decorations: giving you even more control over the look and feel of your cat cafe.

For now, I hope you'll continue to look forward to Cat Cafe Manager! Don't forget to wishlist the game, if you haven't already and share with your friends!
Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Dev Diary 2 (09/28) : A Shifting Game
notes.notes:
[i]Join [url=https://t.co/AVr6LMB0ff]our discord[/url] to hear about new Dev Diaries as soon as they go up![/i]

[h1]Hi again dear cat enthusiast![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/1c4e9e9b23226d3bf666cf2d782314271ad744e9.png[/img]
It’s been a bit, hasn’t it? It's cause we've been real hard at work on Cat Cafe Manager and we've got some big exciting developments to talk about!

[h1]Shifting Shifts![/h1]
The biggest change we’ve recently made has been to the game’s [b]Shifts[/b].
Back when we released the [url=https://youtu.be/hDVQxq06J5o]teaser trailer[/url] the game had 2 clear phases: the ‘management’, and 'shift' phase. You made big management choices in the paused management phase and ran your cafe by ordering staff in the real-time shift phase.

While this sounded great on paper, it turned out this caused the game to be nowhere as chill and relaxing as we’d liked. To keep the shift interesting, we either had to tune it so you were constantly doing something (not very chill OR relaxing!), or have you wait around staring at your cafe going about its merry business before you could make management decisions again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/296dab1b80fe470ed5b37a2121fc02d107ab3743.png[/img]
[i]Ha ha just playing my relaxing cat game ha ha *sweating profusely*[/i]

We decided to [b]scrap[/b] those two phases and, much like the ill-considered bacon-and-cereal breakfast, just [b]smash the two together[/b]! And just like that seemingly appalling meal, the results were unexpectedly delicious…

If you start up the dev build of Cat Cafe Manager now, the game’s clock is always ticking (unless you decide to pause it) and you can make ‘management’ decisions (expanding your cafe, changing up the menu) and 'shift' decisions (directing a poor soul to go mop up that cat wee in the corner) at any time you'd like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/3e85c5e821cd604de6edd2ff5f24abff38f7db76.gif[/img]
[i]While the cafe is open, pop into Build Mode to pop down a fridge[/i]

This might seem like a pretty small change, but it had a huge impact! It removed a lot of waiting from the game (you no longer have to wait for the Shift to end to go buy that new scratching post you were eyeing) and results in a much more organic and relaxed pace.

You can go make big important management decisions while your staff is serving your customers, although you might have to hop in and directly order them around when things get hairy!

[h1]Cat Adoption![/h1]
We’ve been working on so much more stuff, though!
First up: [b]Rick[/b] (who refers to himself in the third person?) finished up the [b]Cat Adoption[/b] mechanic, ready to be polished up at a later time.

Buy cat food from Carla-Lalla’s pet emporium and place it outside your cafe to attract stray cats. Different cat food attracts different cats. To adopt the truly strange mythical cats which roam the woods around Caterwaul, you’ll have to get pretty creative with your food choices!

When a stray pops by and eat the food, they’ll gain a little bit of [b]Trust[/b]. You can also send one of your staff (preferably that cat-whisperer with the really high ‘Cat Care’ skill!) to go pet and befriend the stray, gaining a big Trust boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/79dac07e60d73f3d6e7840c8f00c65117a81b9dd.gif[/img]
[i]Hello cool stray cat! Bye, cool stray cat! (Work in Progress, unpolished gameplay)[/i]

Once a cat's Trust bar is full,  they decide to come hang out at the cafe, and you get to adopt and name them! Some cats are tougher to adopt than others, and will require many visits and their favorite food to win their trust.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/9dcf602fdb50834f56c2185e2342a16140812cd8.png[/img]

[h1]Assigning Staff![/h1]
[b]Rutger[/b] worked hard on the staff assignment UI.
Click on a staff member, or their icon in your HUD, to go into their Assignment Mode. This will highlight the different [b]tasks[/b] that need doing: from cleaning a toilet to calming down a cat with zoomies. Simply click the task and they’ll go do it!

Each staff has different skill ratings, so better make sure to hire staff for all the different tasks in your cafe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/cd171922b96498a4d0fe5ca83ea236515553dabf.gif[/img]
[i]Someone's got to do it, right?[/i]

Oh, and your staff can do tasks all on their own if you can buy a nice hat! Different hats correspond to different activities, so a chef hat will cause a staff member to cook up a storm without having to manually tell them to do so!

[h1]Bring in the Cats![/h1]
[b]Carmen[/b]’s also been hard at work making more cute cats and cat animations!
I’ll just let them speak for themselves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/6e0d6eda8872b857dae430279701e0806cf95a46.gif[/img]

[h1]Much more!?[/h1]
Turns out writing a dev diary after a two-month break is really hard because we’ve just made so much stuff in the meantime! A lot of it is still in progress, like Rutger’s rad new [b]lighting system[/b], Rick’s improvements to the game’s [b]mailbox[/b] and [b]shops[/b] or Carmen’s new [b]town map[/b] and [b]beautiful cat shrine[/b].

I guess we’ll show them off another day...
OK Fine Calm Down here's a GIF and a screenshot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/44d244183cdefbe4f554d7148c447a1112ed8e25.gif[/img]
[i]Work in progress, mind![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/f26158f92378acbd85c7c1494699d6f99b1a6e7e.png[/img]
[i]The shrine is almost ready for you to renovate![/i]

For now, I hope you'll continue to look forward to Cat Cafe Manager!
Thanks for reading!

Roost Games’ Rick

notes.title: Dev Diary 1 (08/05) : Shrines, Shrubs & Scribbles, oh my!
notes.notes:
[i]Join [url=https://t.co/AVr6LMB0ff]our discord[/url] to hear about new Dev Diaries as soon as they go up![/i]

[h1]Hi! Hello![/h1]
If you’re not familiar with Cat Cafe Manager, first of all, congratulations on taking the plunge and clicking on a dev diary for something you knew nothing about, and second of all...
Cat Cafe Manager is our chill business sim in which you run your very own cat cafe, being developed by us: Roost Games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/d0e1a2f092d0aee7dc4919031f32ae94bfb2c31d.png[/img]

For those of you that’d like to get a closer peek at the game’s developments so far and going forward, this dev diary is for you! One of us will write one up every couple of weeks. So lie down, get the closest human to scratch you behind the ear, and read on.

[h1]Announcing Cat Cafe Manager[/h1]
We’ve worked on Cat Cafe Manager since the start of 2020, and decided to share our progress with the world last week Tuesday the 28th. In case you missed it:
[previewyoutube=hDVQxq06J5o;full][/previewyoutube]
For all of you that pressed heart-shaped buttons, retweeted, commented, wishlisted, or decided to hang out on our Discord, thank you so much!! We honestly expected to release our little trailer into the empty void of the internet and not hear much at all. It’s been incredibly invigorating for us to see the positive response Cat Cafe Manager got!

Let's talk about what we've been working on since the announcement.


[h1]Current developments: Shrines, Shrubs & Scribbles, oh my![/h1]

[b]Carmen[/b], Roost Games’ art & animation powerhouse, has spent last week animating a unique sprite for one of our Regulars: [b]Bonner[/b].

Regulars are unique customers that will regularly visit your cat cafe. If they enjoy your cafe you can start conversations with them to slowly build up your friendship!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/b457512ac797605d14aba02974100bc8a33e5193.gif[/img]

Bonner is the town’s old ferryman. He loves adventure, applauding a movie’s credits, and his husband Gavin (who will hopefully be a regular visitor as well!). Different regulars enjoy being with different cats, and Bonner particularly likes nimble cats who like putting up a good (play)fight.

Speaking of Regulars, [b]Rick[/b] (surprise, that's me!) has been writing dialogue for Finley, an up-and-coming young musician that likes to work on her music at your cat cafe. As your friendship develops, you’ll get to learn more about her struggles, and maybe even help her...

Conversations with Regulars include branching choices, built using our dialogue editor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/9b3d94eb1f4944e4816188544ffb4d986854c508.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ab3e4022f0b2a00a21da248e0b5b90b78e56634f.png[/img]

Carmen has also been expanding the nature assets we have as well, so the shrubbery and trees around your cafe are a bit more varied. They will also be used in a very exciting new feature! Read on…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38402580/ab7743e4c19749f3c41f867015c72f49eaf45e1e.png[/img]

[h1]The Shrine[/h1]
Caterwaul Way, the countryside village you’re moving to at the start of your cat cafe story, is home to many old mysteries. One such mystery is the decrepit shrine to an ancient cat god that stands deep within the woods close by the town.

A mysterious figure will ask you to help them restore the old shrine, and it's up to you to decide which parts to restore first. The cats seem to really like it when you renovate this old shrine, but you'll have to work hard to convince all the villagers of Caterwaul Way to help!

[b]Rutger[/b], our programmer, has been working hard to build out this big new feature.
The shrine is in early alpha, and not really at a place where we have a lot to show off yet, but we’re really excited to share it with you in the coming weeks!!


That’s it for right now, cool cats.
If you’re interested in Cat Cafe Manager, please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354830/Cat_Cafe_Manager/]wishlisting the game right here on Steam[/url]. It’s honestly a tremendous help to us! If you’d like to keep up with these dev diaries, consider coming to hang out on [url=https://t.co/AVr6LMB0ff]our Discord[/url]!

Thanks so so much, and see you next time!
Rick
